### Bible Pathway - Jan. 27, 2010
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-jan-27-2010-11625420.html
Passage: Exodus 29:42
Points:
- The entrance to the Tabernacle was the sacred place where regular burnt offerings were presented and where God spoke to His people.
- The single gateway and surrounding linen curtain separated the holy dwelling of the Lord from the camp outside.
- This physical boundary illustrates the righteousness of Christ, which sets believers apart from the world.
- Jesus serves as the true Door through whom believers enter into genuine fellowship with God.
